title: Replace initial-page crackers wallpaper and hearts background with a new non-blocking animation

requirements.summary: Remove any crackers/wallpaper-style background layer from the initial page and ensure the prompt card sits on the gradient only, with no active rendering reference to the generated valentine background asset.
acceptanceCriteria: On the initial page, there is no crackers/wallpaper background visible behind the prompt card.
The frontend codebase contains no active reference that renders `/assets/generated/valentine-bg.dim_1920x1080.png` on the initial page.

file_operations.description: Remove/avoid any initial-page fixed wallpaper/background-image layer styling (including any usage of `/assets/generated/valentine-bg.dim_1920x1080.png` if present) so the initial page shows only the existing gradient behind the prompt card.

Ensure the initial (non-celebration) render path does not include any crackers/wallpaper background layer or any usage of the generated background asset; keep the prompt card over the gradient-only app container.

requirements.summary: Replace the initial-page floating heart emoticon animation (InitialFloatingHearts) with a new continuous background animation behind the prompt card that does not capture pointer events and does not interfere with evasive button interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: `InitialFloatingHearts` is no longer rendered on the initial page, and the heart-emoticon background animation is not visible.
A new background animation is visible on the initial page behind the prompt card and runs continuously.
The background animation layer uses `pointer-events: none` (or equivalent) so all buttons remain fully interactive on desktop and mobile.
The new animation stays confined to the initial page (non-celebration state) and does not alter the celebration overlay behavior.

file_operations.description: Create a new initial-page-only background animation component that renders behind the prompt card, runs continuously, and is non-interactive (ensure the animation layer cannot block clicks/taps).
Stop rendering `InitialFloatingHearts` on the initial page and render the new `InitialBackgroundAnimation` only in the non-celebration state; keep celebration behavior unchanged.

Add/adjust CSS for the new initial-page background animation (including continuous keyframes, correct stacking under the prompt card, and `pointer-events: none`) and remove/disable styling that supported the previous `InitialFloatingHearts` animation so it is no longer visible.
Remove the old heart-emoticon initial background component so it cannot be rendered going forward.
